LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.Mode.Maint: Keep a stock of this recipe's own output topped up. The trigger is the recipe's output itself.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.Mode.Consu: Run this recipe whenever a surplus of some other resource is available, independent of the recipe's own output. E.g. turn excess cotton into cotton dusters.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.SyncFilter: Keep the allowed ingredients in sync with the trigger's threshold filter. Turn this off to trigger on one resource (e.g. hay) while consuming a different one (e.g. meat for carnivore meals).
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.WorkbenchS: Every eligible workbench on the map is managed by this job.
Only workbenches within (or outside, if inverted) a chosen area are managed by this job.
Only the workbenches you explicitly select are managed by this job.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.ManagedByJ: Managed by Colony Manager Production Job ({0})
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.OtherRecip: Switch to a different recipe that produces the same thing, keeping this job's trigger and history unchanged.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.Ingredient: Not linked to a production job.\n\nClick to link this ingredient to a job that produces it, so that job's target count is driven by how much this job needs. Linking covers every allowed ingredient the linked job produces, not just this one.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.LinkedDema: How many of this job's own target a linked producer should keep enough ingredient stock to build from empty, instead of sizing stock to fully refill this job's entire target from scratch. Lower keeps less raw material sitting around; higher smooths over bigger gaps between the producer job's own runs.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.AutoTarget: Automatically compute this job's target count from how much every job linking to it currently needs, instead of setting it manually.

Computed from every linked job's current demand. Only updates when this job is next processed by the manager, not instantly as linked jobs change - turn off "Auto-set target from linked jobs" to set this manually instead.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.AutoRestri: Automatically restrict this job's allowed ingredients to only those that produce something at least one linked job currently allows, instead of leaving every ingredient enabled regardless of whether anything downstream can use it. E.g. if linked jobs only allow bear and muffalo meat, a "butcher creature" job with this on only butchers bear and muffalo corpses. Only has an effect for recipes with a real ingredient-to-output mapping (like butchery); other recipes are unaffected. Only updates when this job is next processed by the manager, and only while at least one linked job wants something - your own ingredient choices are left alone otherwise.
LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.Production.DemandAggr: Target enough to satisfy every linked job at once. Safer against multiple jobs depleting stock at the same time, at the cost of more production.
Target only as much as the single most demanding linked job needs. Economizes colonist effort, at the risk of occasional shortfalls when multiple linked jobs draw stock down at once.
